(a) Air Vent Mode Control System

Air flow changes as follows.
① Air mix control servo motor shaft moves.
② Program switch is changed.
(Signal is transmitted to relay box)
③ Relay box rotates a motor in air vent mode control servo motor.
④ Servo motor links move.
⑤ Each damper moves.
